description: Photosynthesis is the process by which plants convert energy from the sun into chemical energy. It is broken down into two stages, the Light-dependent Reaction and the Calvin Cycle. During the Light-dependent Reaction, light energy is used to split water molecules, releasing oxygen as a byproduct, and is then used to produce ATP and NADPH.
